name: Academy of Aerospace Solid Propulsion Technology (AASPT)
aliases: Academy of Aerospace Solid Propulsion Technology
supervisors: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC)

evidence.summary: CASC lists the Academy of Aerospace Solid Propulsion Technology (航天动力技术研究院) among its eight research academies. CASC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says it researches, designs, builds and tests strategic and tactical missiles as well as launch vehicles and spacecraft. The US Commerce Department added it to the Military End-User List in December 2020, having determined that it is a military end user.
It belongs to CASC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise and a cornerstone of China’s national security strategy.
